role: Material and form concept for native Blender reconstruction
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: design concept for Ferrigura's compact 3D metallic diagram logo, to be reconstructed as real Blender geometry. The reference image is Ferrolink, the approved sibling logo: match its elegance, sculptural rounded bevels, glossy satin metal, broad rolling softbox reflections, silver steel and rich reddish-brown copper. It is a material and lighting reference, not the subject to copy.
Create ONE refined compact flowchart sculpture, containing exactly three blank diagram nodes: a silver-steel capsule, a warm polished copper decision diamond, and a silver-steel softly beveled rectangle. They float in subtly different planes with convincing thickness. Compose them as a balanced compact triangular graph inside a roughly square silhouette, with the capsule upper left, diamond upper right, and rectangle below. Connect the three nodes with TWO clearly exposed, continuous rounded right-angle connector rails, substantial enough to read at 32px, but visibly separate from node faces. Each rail genuinely meets an edge of a node; no loose sticks, accidental intersections, overlapping plates or impossible geometry. Allow generous empty space between the nodes so both connectors are visible.
The object must feel sculpted, precious and beautiful like the Ferrolink reference. Use smoothly crowned faces and generous machined bevels to carry luminous reflections across the metal, a rich dark-to-light range, crisp silver highlights and restrained warm copper. Gray steel faces must still show strong gloss and softbox gradients, not flat matte slabs. Only three clean forms, no bolts, labels, screws or decorative detail. View from a shallow three-quarter angle, preserving recognizable shapes; real edge thickness and a small change of plane, no extreme foreshortening. Full complete object centered, generous transparent padding, all negative spaces genuinely transparent. No background, floor, board, enclosing tile, cast shadow on a backdrop, text, watermark or other items.
